title: DO NOT MERGE — reproduction: removing the `app` registration breaks stored pages of kind `app` (objectui#9263)
body:
# ⛔ DO NOT MERGE — this branch is a REPRODUCTION, not a fix

Part of #9263. ⛔ Deliberately no closing keyword: the ruling this branch executed rests on a premise that this branch itself falsified, so merging must not close that card.

The work landed here exactly as ruled, and then the measurement that was supposed to justify it turned out to have probed the wrong population. The branch is left intact because it is a working reproduction: a required shard and the live lane are red on it, and they are red for the right reason. Full finding on the card as [`5700884796`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9263#issuecomment-5700884796).

## What is wrong, in one paragraph

`app` is not a node-type name. It is a stored page **KIND**. `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx` renders every stored page document by writing the document's `type` — which per `@objectstack/spec` is the page kind `record|home|app|utility|list` — straight into the SchemaNode discriminator, with no fallback for an unregistered value:

```
// `type` stays the SchemaNode discriminator ComponentRegistry dispatches on.
// The spec's page KIND (`record|home|app|utility|list`) rides `pageType`, which
// PageRenderer reads — without this mapping every page fell back to
// `pageType: 'record'` …
type: (page as any).type || 'page',
pageType: (page as any).type,
```

So the five registrations on `PageRenderer` are the five page kinds, registered so that passthrough resolves — which is why the label reads `App Page`. Removing `app` does not retire a colliding node name; it stops every stored page of kind `app` from rendering, and paints the OBJUI-001 panel where the page was.

## The evidence, in the order it arrived

**1 — a required shard went red, on a spelling no instrument on this card had probed.** `Test (shard 3/4)` fails with `Unknown component type: ui:app`. The registration is `register('app', PageRenderer, { ...pageMeta, … })` and `pageMeta` carries `namespace: 'ui'` with no `skipFallback`, so per `packages/core/src/registry/Registry.ts` it stores **two** runtime keys: `ui:app` and bare `app`.

⭐ Every instrument on this card probed only the bare one — the card's original census, my re-take, and the repository's own `deriveRegistryKeys`. That derivation cannot statically resolve `{ ...pageMeta }` to a namespace, so `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` carries no `ui:` twin either, and the 644-to-643 reading read like a complete removal proof. **Two "independent" instruments agreed because they were blind in the same direction.** A whole-tree fixed-string census for the namespaced spelling resolves 1 line (a registry-parity roster in `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx`), against controls `ui:page` 2 lines and `ui:text` 35 lines in 15 files, absent-token control 0.

**2 — the live lane went red, only on this head.** `Live E2E` succeeded on `52bdbe331`, `60d353023` and `f8388535d9` the same day and fails only here, in `e2e/live/master-detail.spec.ts`, waiting for the heading of `/apps/showcase_app/page/showcase_project_workspace`. That route is `page/:pageName` in `AppContent.tsx`, which is `PageView`, which is the mapping above.

**3 — the out-of-repo census, with firing controls in the same pass.** Page documents in ObjectStack's own reference application (`objectstack-ai/objectstack`, `examples/**`, `definePage` sources), by kind:

| page kind | documents |
|---|---|
| **`app`** | **6** |
| `home` — control | 8 |
| `list` — control | 4 |
| `record` — control | 3 |
| `utility` | 0 |
| absent-token control | 0 |

All six in `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/`: `command-center.page.ts`, `contact-form.page.ts`, `new-project-wizard.page.ts`, `page-variables.page.ts`, `project-workspace.page.ts`, `styling-gallery.page.ts`. These are real authored documents in the published release the live lane pins, not fixtures.

**4 — ⚠️ the in-repo zero was not merely incomplete; this branch edited the evidence.** `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-single-h1.test.tsx` documents its fixture as *"The showcase master-detail page, reduced to the parts that render headings"*, carrying `name: 'showcase_project_workspace'` and `label: 'New Project + Tasks'` — an in-repo **model of the very document that broke** — and it was authored `type: 'app'`. This branch changed it to `type: 'page'` so it would keep passing. A fixture that mirrors a real document is evidence about that document, and editing it to agree with the change destroyed the signal instead of reading it. That is why 2702 component tests went green over a change that breaks six shipped pages.

Nothing in this repository renders a stored page through the real `SchemaRenderer`: the only `PageView` test mocks `SchemaRenderer` out entirely and uses a page of kind `page`. That coverage gap is why the premise survived.

## What this means for the ruling

Option **A** was adopted on the explicit ground that migration cost was zero, and option **D** ("measure first") was called moot because *"the in-repo count is zero and the out-of-repo count is the maintainer's to judge"*. Both halves have moved: the out-of-repo count is six documents in ObjectStack's own showcase before any customer application is considered, and the in-repo count was never a reading of this channel at all. ⛔ Re-approving that is neither the dev seat's nor the PM seat's call.

⚠️ **The same mechanism sits under objectui#9576**, where `utility` / `home` / `record` are queued for a declare-or-unregister disposition on the reading that they are "registered but never declared". They are the same page-kind passthrough; unregistering them would break the 8 `home` and 3 `record` documents counted above by exactly this route.

## What is in the diff, and why it is still here

Nine files. ⛔ Nothing was re-registered, no assertion was weakened, and no test was skipped, disabled or quarantined. Left intact so the reproduction stays runnable and so a reviewer can see precisely what the removal touches.

Three of the nine sit **outside** the dispatched file surface. Each was mechanically forced by the sanctioned deletion rather than chosen, and each is declared here with its alternative, per file:

| file | what made it unavoidable | the alternative, and why it was not taken |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts` | GENERATED from the registration calls. Removing the registration drifts it — `node scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs --check` went red on this branch and is green after regeneration. One line. | Leaving it stale ships a validator that blesses a type the runtime no longer has, which is the exact "phantom" direction objectui#5115 filed. Hand-editing it is forbidden by its own generated-file header. |
| `scripts/container-declaration-baseline.json` | A ratchet to zero whose second assertion fails on a **listed** tag that has stopped violating: *"these no longer violate — delete their lines from the baseline (the list may only shrink)"*. Its row had to go with the registration. | Leaving it ships a red `container-declaration-ratchet.test.tsx`. Adding an exclusion instead would convert a ratchet into an exemption list, which that file's own header forbids by name. |
| `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs` | That gate judges every `type` literal in a docs code block against the registry with **no channel awareness**, so the three pages teaching the app-document spelling turn red the moment `app` leaves the universe. Three (file, value) exemptions, its own prescribed remedy. | Editing the three documentation pages instead would change authored content the ruling explicitly leaves alone. objectui#8802 — which retired the bare `kanban` node key while keeping the view-type spelling — is the same shape, exempted the same way. |

⚠️ One further file would have had to move and deliberately has **not**: `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx` carries `ui:app` in a roster its own parity case holds equal to the registry, so three of its cases are red. It is a mechanical fixture and shrinking it would be in scope — but that would be polishing a change that must not land, so the red is left standing as part of the reproduction.

## The `changeset-claim-re-read` gate ([`5700458847`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9263#issuecomment-5700458847)), answered

The gate judges name resolution only; the question it will not answer is the one below. Seven pending changesets name a file this diff touches. **All seven were read as paragraphs, and none went false because of this branch.** Each verdict is a reading, not a recollection.

Four turn on membership in the generated `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES`. Instrument: exact entry-form membership at the merge base and at head, with controls — `page` present in both (it fires), `app` 1 then 0 (it detects this branch's own change), absent token 0 in both.

| changeset | what it claims | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `6416-plugin-report-namespace.md` | the three `report:*` keys were dropped | still true — 0 / 0, unchanged |
| `7122-spec-17-3-0-parity-reconciliation.md` | `user:profile` retired across three sites | still true — `user:profile` 0 / 0, `element:form` 0 / 0 |
| `7704-schema-registry-chatbot-keys.md` | the list keeps all three chatbot keys | still true — 1 / 1 each |
| `8802-8257-8008-kanban-gantt-family-retirement.md` | namespaced pair survives, bare pair gone | still true — `view:kanban` and `view:gantt` 1 / 1, bare `kanban` and `gantt` 0 / 0 |

The only entry this branch moves is `app`, which none of those four paragraphs mentions.

- **`7926-page-node-refuses-actions.md`** quotes a published command, so it was re-run verbatim in the form it is printed in, at both revisions: `git grep -ni action` over `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx` returns the **same four lines** at the merge base and at head. Controls in the same pass: a token that is in the file returns 5, an absent token returns nothing. ⇒ unmoved by this branch. (The sentence says "only the import and its render" while the command returns two comment lines besides; that reads identically at the merge base, so it is not something this branch did.)
- **`8499-node-slot-registered-arms.md`** — the paragraph the gate quoted says `my-component` "carries a written exemption in `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`". **Still true**: both of that key's entries are present and untouched; this branch adds three `app` entries on three other pages and moves no line of theirs. Its "nine … the ninth" is a count of `type` spellings at declared node slots resolving in no union arm — a `packages/types` question this branch does not touch. ⚠️ A **different** paragraph in the same changeset carries "`KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` carries 656 registered types … 558 to 505". Measured: the list holds **644** entries at this branch's merge base, so that figure was already 12 short before this branch existed; this branch takes the live number to 643. ⇒ **not falsified by this branch**, and correcting another card's declaration for a staleness this branch did not cause would attribute the repair to the wrong change. The gate's second route — naming the superseded reading rather than rewriting the paragraph — is the one that applies, and it is moot while this branch does not land.
- **`page-source-tailwind-prose-retraction-5469.md`** claims the `kind === 'html'` dispatch-arm comment in `page.tsx` does **not** project into the published `.d.ts`. **Still true, and measured rather than argued**: the built `packages/components/dist/renderers/layout/page.d.ts` is 219 bytes and carries only the `PageRenderer` declaration. Probes for that comment and for this branch's new module-scope comment both return 0; the firing control — a comment known to project, in the sibling `html-elements.d.ts` — returns 1; absent control 0. So neither the cited comment nor the one this branch adds reaches the published surface.

## Verification, for the record

All heavy runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`; each verdict is that wrapper's own `VERDICT command-exit` line, and every exit code was captured to disk before any pipe.

Green on this head: `@object-ui/components` 277 files / 2702 tests · `packages/cli/` + `scripts/` 182 files / 5081 tests · `apps/console/` + `examples/` 133 files / 3336 tests · `turbo run build` 43/43 · `turbo run type-check` 11/11 · `lint:root` and both package lints exit 0 · `pnpm check` exit 0 over 632 files · thirty `check:*` gates, including three re-run after a build because their first run printed a prerequisite and therefore measured nothing, and `check:node-esm-load` re-run with `--force-build` after its provenance leg caught turbo replaying another worktree's artifacts.

RED on this head, both correctly: `Test (shard 3/4)` — three cases in `widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx` — and `Live E2E (informational)`. ⛔ Neither is a flake and neither is unrelated; both are this change.

⚠️ **The whole-package suite is what should have caught this and did not get run early enough.** `packages/components`, `packages/cli`, `scripts`, `apps/console` and `examples` were all run and green; `packages/app-shell` — which holds both the registry-parity roster and `PageView` — was only reached on a later, wider run. Running the narrow affected-package set first is what let a green reading stand for several hours.

`dispatch-gates.mjs` is objectstack's and refuses cross-repo, so `--ran` reconciliation is **UNAVAILABLE** and is not faked; `check-expected-skips.mjs` carries objectstack's workflow roster and was deliberately not pointed at this board.
